title: Bell of Madness
description: A giant stone hand emerges from the ground holding up a massive dark bell covered in red squares, from which a fiery red spiked sun-like face with glowing eyes emerges. Below, a lone figure in a blue and red checkered cloak stands on a path lined with red tiles, facing an army of hooded figures, with a gothic castle visible in the background under a dark stormy sky with a yellow moon.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy scene of a colossal grey stone hand rising from the earth, palm up, supporting an enormous iron bell covered in glowing red squares. From the bell emerges a terrifying red spiked sun creature with evil glowing eyes and colorful energy ribbons. In the foreground a solitary figure in a blue and red checkered cloak stands on a path of red tiles facing rows of thousands of identical hooded figures. Behind the hand is a gothic castle, dramatic stormy sky with yellow moon, waterfalls flowing from the hand's fingers, highly detailed cinematic painting
